### Vocabulary in scope

New at this step:
- system context — it is necessary that each system context spans at least 1 sort of system (HCP/README.md — Jargon: system context)
- sort of system — it is possible that each sort of system is the sort of at least 1 object (HCP/README.md — Jargon: sort of system, the universal category of a system's substantial bearer)
- kind of property — it is necessary that each kind of property carries at most 1 dimension (HCP/README.md — Jargon: kind of property, distinct from its dimension)
